# `morphir ui`

- **Usage:** `morphir ui [--workspace-extension <ID>] [--no-open] [WORKSPACE]`

Open the Morphir development workbench in a browser

## Arguments
- **`[WORKSPACE]`** — Morphir development workspace to open. Defaults to the current directory

## Flags
- **`--workspace-extension <ID>`** — Use one installed workspace-capability extension by ID
- **`--no-open`** — Print the one-time launch URL instead of opening a browser
